title: Assembly: Stack and Queue
description: Practice stack and queue in Assembly.

; Assembly program
section .data
    msg db 'Stack and Queue',0
section .text
    global _start
_start:

    mov ebx, 1
    mov ecx, msg
    int 0x80
    mov eax, 1
    xor ebx, ebx
    int 0x80
